stim_id.Description: File name of the clip without extension.

stim_file.Description: Path relative to stimuli/ of the presented file, which is part of this dataset.

source_title.Description: Title of the source work or upload.

source_id.Description: Identifier of the source (YouTube id, archive or deposit identifier, clip name).

source_url.Description: Where the source can be obtained (official page, upload or deposit). Not a copy made by us.

source_in_s.Description: Start of the clip in the YouTube video, from the HACS file name.

rights.Description: Rights note. 'third-party; not included': the video belongs to its rights holder and is not part of this dataset.

fps.Description: Frame rate of the file described by sha256 (ffprobe).

width.Description: Frame width of the file described by sha256 (ffprobe).

height.Description: Frame height of the file described by sha256 (ffprobe).

n_frames.Description: Number of video frames of the file described by sha256 (ffprobe packet count).

audio.Description: yes if the file described by sha256 has an audio stream.

sha256.Description: SHA-256 of stimuli/<stim_file> (the file in this dataset).

verification.Description: How identity and timing were checked.

Levels.verified: identity and timing checked against data or files of this dataset
Levels.likely: identity verified, timing from one anchor, or two independent anchors agree
Levels.unknown: not checked or not resolvable from public material
